Methods and referencesboilerplate generated from this run; check before use

Temporal interference stimulation was simulated in TI-Toolbox with SimNIBS 4.6.0 [Saturnino2019b] on the head model of subject 101 [Puonti2020]. 2 channels (F7–P7 and F8–P8) each delivered 1.5 mA through ellipse 8×8 mm electrodes with 4 mm gel; positions from the EEG10-10_Cutini_2011 layout [Jurcak2007]. Tissue conductivities were isotropic SimNIBS standard values.

The TI envelope was taken as the maximal modulation amplitude over field orientations [Grossman2017]; in grey matter its 99.9th percentile was 0.540 V/m and its median 0.255 V/m.
